source_observations.explanation: validatePacket uses exact(packet, ['scope', 'criteria', 'documents']) and Set(packet.criteria.map(c => c.id)).size === packet.criteria.length to enforce packet structure and unique criteria IDs.
validatePacket rejects invalid document hashes via d.sha256 !== sha256(d.content) and private files via /(.*)(\.env|auth\.json|credentials?[^\/]*|.*\.(dpapi|sqlite))/i.test(d.file).
validateResult ensures criteria coverage via seen.size !== criteria.size and rejects missing/unknown references through exact(result, Object.keys(RESULT_SCHEMA.properties)) and refs/values checks.

validateResult enforces PASS evidence coverage via criterion.evidenceKinds.some(kind => !check.evidence_ids.some(ref => docs.get(ref).kind === kind)) and observation.quote inclusion via doc.content.includes(observation.quote).
